name: agent-desktop
description: DijiPeople desktop attendance and activity agent
author: DijiPeople

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run copy:renderer
scripts.build:renderer: tsc src/renderer/login.ts src/renderer/device-permissions.ts src/renderer/location-request.ts --target ES2020 --module ES2020 --moduleResolution bundler --outDir src/renderer --skipLibCheck
scripts.dist:win: dotenv -e .env -- npm run build && dotenv -e .env -- electron-builder --win nsis
